translation_en: Being without knowledge is being without light.
meaning_en: Education illuminates life; ignorance leaves you in the dark.
notes: Widely attested; among the best-known Somali proverbs. VERIFY SOMALI

translation_en: One finger cannot wash a face.
meaning_en: Cooperation is essential; nobody achieves much alone.

proverb_so: Nin aan dhul marin dhaayo ma leh.
translation_en: A man who has not traveled has no eyes.
meaning_en: Travel and experience are what open one's understanding.
